built_in_effects.name: Reverb
built_in_effects.notes: Set per patch: Small Room, Medium Room, Medium Hall, Large Hall, Plate, Delay 1-3, or Off; time 1-8, level 0-7. Applies to keys assigned to MIX; keys sent to multi outs are dry (multi outs 5-6 unusable while reverb is on).

global_features: Rhythm part is a 9th part with its own MIDI channel (Parts 1-8 + Rhythm)
Rhythm setup covers keys 24-108; the factory map fills 35-97 with all 63 preset rhythm tones, each used once
Any key can instead play one of 64 programmable LA tones
32 shared partials; rhythm tones use 1-3 partials; partial reserve per part
Rhythm part output level 0-100; no part-wide pan or key range for the rhythm part
Outputs: stereo MIX plus 6 multi outs
The 63 tones are built from about 30 raw rhythm PCM samples (Bank 1 001-030)
No mute/exclusive (choke) parameter in the rhythm setup
pack_contents: 18 named WAVs: Bassdrum, Bongo, Cabasa, Conga, Cowbell H, Cowbell L, Crash, Hat Closed, Hat Open, Hat Pedal, Ride, Rimshot, Snaredrum-01..03, Tambourine, Tom, Woodblock - a subset of the 63 rhythm tones. Inferred: Hat Pedal = key 44 Open High Hat-2 (the D-110 has no pedal hat); Cowbell H/L probably High/Low Agogo (only one Cowbell tone exists). Bassdrum, Tom, Bongo, Conga and the 3 snares cannot be pinned to specific r-numbers. No readme or licence.

global_features: Rhythm part is the 6th part of a Performance (5 synth parts + rhythm)
Rhythm setup keys E1-G7 (MIDI 28-103, inferred from Roland numbering)
Rhythm Shift -28 to +24 semitones for the whole kit
Each key can use any Original Tone (internal I1-I3, or card/user media)
Per-key filter: LPF / HPF / BPF / Bypass
Per-key Mute parameter names another key to cut (choke); factory assignments unknown

global_features: 16-voice polyphony (8 with two sounds per note)
12-bit sampling at 30 kHz or 15 kHz
Samples can be placed anywhere in MIDI range 0-127 (drum machine / sequencer triggering)
Per-sample tuning, vibrato, 8-stage envelope; static LPF/HPF (no filter envelope)
Audio input can trigger up to 8 keys (drum replacement)
Five factory disks, including a drum disk (acoustic, electronic and gated drums); Roland library disks in L-, RSB- and USB-series
No fixed kit layout - the key map depends on the disk loaded; no documented exclusive groups

global_features: Monophonic: one VCO + sub-oscillator, so every new note cuts the last
VCO waveforms Noise / Saw / Square / Pulse (PWM), range 32' to 2'
24 dB/oct low-pass VCF; resonance self-oscillates into a sine near the top of its travel
VCF envelope mode: positive / inverted / envelope follower; ENV depth 0-10; LFO MOD
ADSR triggered by Gate+Trigger, Gate only, or LFO
VCA mode HOLD / ENV / GATE
LFO 0.2-25 Hz: sine (with delay), square, sample & hold
CV/Gate in and out; manual suggests triggering the Bass Drum chart from a CR-series or Boss DR-55 trigger output
